summary: Kandal M Venture Limited, a Nasdaq-listed Cambodian contract manufacturer of affordable luxury leather goods, furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026 reporting unaudited interim results for the six months ended September 30, 2026, the first half of fiscal 2027. Revenue rose 21% to US$9.5 million from US$7.9 million, gross profit grew 45% to US$2.15 million, gross margin expanded 3.8 points to 22.5%, and operating income reached US$538,000. No transaction, corporate action, or special-situation terms are stated. Watch for operational execution and customer-concentration risk, not event-driven arbitrage.
